svg.title: Agent harness benchmark (illustration)
svg.desc: Illustration with synthetic data. A dark isometric platform floats above a glow. From a shaft in its centre, around the crystal Tentaflake mark, blue tentacles rise and hold four dark, armoured agents from above: the harness. Two larger tentacles reach around the platform from below. Each agent stands in its own marked field beside a hologram of its isolated Linux network with a client, a router, a firewall and the services web and admin. An evaluator drone hovers on a separate plate, attached to no tentacle, and probes each network in turn; lamps show whether web is reachable and admin is blocked. The task is 'repair routing and firewall'. The outcomes are invented for the picture.
svg.text: same task · isolated runs · independent checks
